literal: If one speaks of the rolling dice gain without ceasing, the wealth gain will go outside and fall.
translation: If a person constantly speaks of and plays the rolling dice game without ceasing, their accumulated wealth and income will depart and fall into the hands of others.
modern: உருளும் பகடையின் லாபத்தைப் பற்றி இடைவிடாமல் பேசிக்கொண்டு (சூதாடிக்கொண்டு) இருந்தால், ஒருவனுடைய செல்வமும் வருவாயும் அவனை விட்டு நீங்கிப் பிறரிடம் போய்ச் சேரும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against the addictive nature of gambling. The poet contrasts 'உருளாயம்' (the gain from rolling dice) with 'பொருளாயம்' (the gain of real wealth and income). If a person is constantly obsessed with the rolling dice and speaks of it without ceasing ('ஓவாது கூறின்'), their actual earned wealth and income will vanish ('போஒய்') and end up in the hands of others ('புறமே படும்'). The word 'ஓவாது' highlights how the relentless, non-stop pursuit of gambling leads directly to financial ruin.
